exercise_merged.name: exercise_merged
exercise_merged.value: "exercise"."merged_into_id" IS NULL OR ("exercise"."merged_into_id" <> "exercise"."id" AND "exercise"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL)

change_images.name: change_images
change_images.value: ("change"."operation" = 'insert' AND "change"."before" IS NULL AND "change"."after" IS NOT NULL) OR ("change"."operation" = 'update' AND "change"."before" IS NOT NULL AND "change"."after" IS NOT NULL) OR ("change"."operation" = 'delete' AND "change"."before" IS NOT NULL AND "change"."after" IS NULL)

pain_report_check_in_zone.name: pain_report_check_in_zone
pain_report_check_in_zone.where: "pain_report"."check_in_id" IS NOT NULL AND "pain_report"."deleted_at" IS NULL

pain_report_source.name: pain_report_source
pain_report_source.value: ("pain_report"."session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "pain_report"."phase" IS NOT NULL AND "pain_report"."check_in_id" IS NULL) OR ("pain_report"."session_id" IS NULL AND "pain_report"."phase" IS NULL AND "pain_report"."strength_set_id" IS NULL AND "pain_report"."session_item_id" IS NULL AND "pain_report"."check_in_id" IS NOT NULL)

pain_report_anchor_phase.name: pain_report_anchor_phase
pain_report_anchor_phase.value: ("pain_report"."strength_set_id" IS NULL AND "pain_report"."session_item_id" IS NULL) OR "pain_report"."phase" IN ('during', 'between')

program_item_target.name: program_item_target
program_item_target.value: ("program_item"."reps_min" IS NOT NULL AND "program_item"."reps_max" >= "program_item"."reps_min" AND "program_item"."duration_min_seconds" IS NULL AND "program_item"."duration_max_seconds" IS NULL) OR ("program_item"."reps_min" IS NULL AND "program_item"."reps_max" IS NULL AND "program_item"."duration_min_seconds" IS NOT NULL AND "program_item"."duration_max_seconds" >= "program_item"."duration_min_seconds")

session_end.name: session_end
session_end.value: ("session"."status" = 'in_progress') = ("session"."ended_at" IS NULL) AND ("session"."ended_at" IS NULL OR "session"."ended_at" >= "session"."started_at")

session_variant.name: session_variant
session_variant.value: "session"."variant_id" IS NULL OR "session"."slot_id" IS NOT NULL
